comparison.objective: Pinch open a pulse oximeter and clip it onto a manikin finger; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Compliant pinch-opening and clip placement versus recessed hex-key alignment, counterholding, fine collar rotation, and bounded tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Oximeter must be clipped onto the finger; candidate requires repeatable safe stopping under specified energy/velocity and a drift-resistant lock. No detailed oximeter rubric/spec is available.
comparison.reason: Spring-clip placement is a different tested ability from iterative dynamic commissioning and mechanical setting retention.
